title: IVG Smart Max Purple Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Purple Lemonade IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod delivers a zesty, sparkling flavour with a fruity twist. The sharp tang of Lemonade is lifted by juicy berry notes, creating a refreshing blend with a lightly fizzy edge. Each pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, accompanied by a 10ml refill reservoir that keeps the pod topped up during use. Designed to deliver up to 12,000 puffs depending on usage, this refill system removes the need for messy refills or coil replacements. Using mesh coil technology, the pod produces smooth vapour and consistent flavour delivery all the way through. Made exclusively for the IVG Smart Max 12K Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, setup is fast and simple — just click the pod into place and start vaping. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
